item.title: HOOSER: On leadership: Hawaii can and must do better
item.description: Friends and fellow citizens, there is a sad and ugly stain upon all of us who believe in our democratic form of government, and who work hard every day to encourage others to believe and participate.

item.title: Happy Camper for Wednesday, February 25, 2026
item.description: Today is the final day of the 2026 Kauai Quilt Show and Boutique that’s running at the Kauai Society of Artists gallery (is that buzzing sound coming from Bubbah’s Toy Box?). Congratulations to Bebe Nichols for earning the Viewer’s Choice voting for her hand-quilted Hawaiian quilt (Lea Ingram loved the color combinations). You can see that quilt today up to 5 p.m. before the quilters wrap everything up until the next show.

item.title: Planned new telescopes for Haleakala draw strong opposition
item.description: As the military moves forward on its plans to build as many as seven new telescopes on the summit of Haleakala, opposition to the project is mounting on Maui.

item.title: Bebe gets the Viewers’ Choice winner at the Kauai Quilt Show and Boutique
item.description: LIHUE — With the Kauai Quilt Show and Boutique scheduled to close on Wednesday, the winners of the Viewer’s Choice awards were announced Monday.

item.title: Hundreds enjoy the 49th Annual Waimea Town Celebration
item.description: The West Side of Kauai, and more specifically, Waimea Town, were the big winners of the 49th annual Waimea Town Celebration that wrapped up eight days of activities and events with the Ho‘olaule‘a on Saturday in the shadow of the old sugar mill.

item.title: 40 years and counting for Chris “Naka” Nakamura
item.description: LIHUE — Feb. 18 was proclaimed Naka Day, and the Department of Water hosted a company breakfast to celebrate Chris “Naka” Nakamura’s job tenure with the DOW.

item.title: Trump touts economic record in State of the Union
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — U.S. President Donald Trump touted his economic record during the longest State of the Union address in history on Tuesday, boasting that he had ushered in a “golden age” as he sought to project an aura of success at a fraught moment for his presidency.

item.title: Mayor welcomes state champions
item.description: LIHUE — Kapaa High School boys soccer had the distinction of being the sole Kauai Interscholastic Federation squad to bring home the gold hardware in the seven winter sports offered by the Hawaii High School Athletic Association.
